The six low challenges (W3-008, -009, -011, -012, -013, -014) are each a true fact or count stated without its tier word or layer, which answers TRIAGE-DAN-01 with yes for all six listed rows in this cluster. TRIAGE-DAN-02, -03, -04 and -05 have no rows in this cluster.
